data.label: Nudix N-terminal substrate-binding loop
data.description: Substrate-binding segment in Nudix hydrolases and related diphosphate-handling enzymes, firing on an N-terminal strand/loop region upstream of the Nudix box that contacts the nucleotide/sugar-diphosphate substrate

data.label: Catalytic beta-strand in pseudouridine synthases
data.description: A conserved β-strand region within the catalytic domain of pseudouridine synthases (RluC/RsuA family and related rRNA/tRNA pseudouridine synthases), located downstream of the catalytic Asp, often containing a hydrophobic/basic motif resembling "(E/G)(R/K)-I/M-V/I-R-V".

data.label: P-loop NTPase switch module
data.description: Conserved P-loop NTPase nucleotide-binding/switch module: the stretch surrounding the Walker A P-loop and extending into the adjacent hydrolysis-coupling elements (Walker B and Switch/Sensor helices/loops) that transmit NTP state to conformational change in diverse motor and signaling NTPases

data.label: N-terminal β→α loop motif
data.description: Conserved β→α loop in an early N-terminal α/β scaffold—most commonly the SAM-binding "motif I" loop of class I S-adenosyl-L-methionine–dependent methyltransferases; the feature also marks analogous loops in other early α/β domains beyond MTases (including RNA/translation, replication, and transcription/PTS-linked regulators).
